accommodation.notes: A room in a share house, weekly rent times 52/12. Low: Monash, 275 a week (Clayton, Melbourne). Typical: PropTrack national median room, 290 a week (December 2023). High: UTS, 550 a week (near UTS, Sydney). Bills and internet may cost extra.

other_sources.publisher: University of Technology Sydney, cost of living in Sydney

food.notes: Food and groceries in Sydney, a monthly range that UTS bases on the Study Australia calculator; typical is the midpoint. Student-budget guidance: no worker-specific range was found.

source.publisher: University of Technology Sydney, cost of living in Sydney

transport.notes: Public transport, 25 to 50 a week (Monash, Melbourne) times 52/12; typical is the midpoint. Sydney's Opal adult weekly cap is 50, the same top end. A car is not included.

other_sources.publisher: Transport for NSW, adult Opal fares

phone_data.notes: Boost prepaid plans are 28 days: 28 (8GB), 39 (60GB) and 74 (150GB) a recharge, times 13/12 for a calendar month. Typical is the 39 plan. The larger data amounts are promotions for the first six recharges.

mandatory_deductions.notes: Tax withheld from a working holiday maker's pay from 1 July 2026: 15% up to 45,000 a year, 30% on each dollar above, so the share never passes 30%. A tax resident pays resident rates plus a 2% Medicare levy instead.

source.publisher: Australian Taxation Office, Schedule 15, published 17 June 2026

other_sources.publisher: Australian Taxation Office, resident tax rates, updated 13 August 2026

rental_bond.notes: Four weeks' rent, the most a NSW landlord may take as a bond, on the weekly rents behind accommodation (275, 290, 550). Other states have their own limits: not checked.

source.publisher: NSW Government (NSW Fair Trading), costs at the start of a tenancy

sim_card.notes: A Boost SIM or eSIM includes the first recharge, which is counted in phone_data.
